name: Demetrius
summary: A silversmith in Ephesus who made silver shrines for the goddess Diana. Warning that Paul's preaching put their trade in danger, he stirred up the craftsmen and set off an uproar in the city.

key_moments.title: Stirs Up a Riot in Ephesus
key_moments.description: Demetrius gathered the craftsmen and warned that Paul's teaching against gods made with hands was turning people away and putting their trade in danger. They grew angry and shouted praise to Diana, and uproar spread through the whole city.

key_moments.title: Told to Take His Case to Court
key_moments.description: The town clerk quieted the crowd and said that if Demetrius and his craftsmen had a complaint against anyone, the courts were open. He warned that they could be called to account for the riot, and he sent the crowd away.
